name: crapide-vscode
description: CRAP metric integration for VS Code and Cursor (bootstrap only)

virtualWorkspaces.description: CRAP analysis requires a file-backed workspace and an external CLI.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: CRAP analysis runs an external CLI and project tests.

scripts.format:check: prettier --config .prettierrc.json --check src test ../../test/e2e/json-contract-smoke.cjs eslint.config.mjs .vscode-test.cjs package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format: prettier --config .prettierrc.json --write src test ../../test/e2e/json-contract-smoke.cjs eslint.config.mjs .vscode-test.cjs package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit:built && vscode-test
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run test:unit:built
